verdict.rationale: Resend is fundamentally an API-first product with a comprehensive, documented REST API (emails, batch, broadcasts, domains, webhooks, suppressions, API keys), an OpenAPI spec, SMTP integration, official SDKs/CLI, and llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable documentation confirmed by live probes. This directly satisfies driving the product via a documented public API for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of API completeness/versioning stability beyond vendor docs and probes.
